development_history: Authored from the docs/44 clause 'Canonical derivation is bound under the writer's own authority' and the docs/786 F-R3-2 row at base_commit (the repair commit), after the unit-level expectations of reference/tests/test_809_evidence_reference_authorization.py were preregistered at 10a0d70e and executed once on the unmodified tree (29 failed, 9 passed). No case of this fixture was executed before the independent comparison.
independence: Expected outcomes were written from the contract documents listed in contract_sources at base_commit, clause by clause (`clauses` on every case), before this fixture was first executed by the runner, and compared to those clauses by a separate reviewer before that first execution. A failing expectation is a finding, never a reason to edit this fixture; a corrected expectation requires a superseding -v2 of this generation with a recorded reason. Observables under `controls` are positive controls expected for falsifiability (a withhold-everything runtime must fail), not derivations of a clause; observables under `implementation_evidence` are recorded, never expected. No frozen holdout phrase, #644 or -v3 fixture vocabulary is used.
